summary: Cycurion, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing its binding agreement to acquire Halo Privacy and fully integrate HavenX. The acquirer is Cycurion; no financial terms (price per share, consideration, premium) are disclosed. The board endorsed the acquisition as part of a disciplined growth strategy. The transaction is expected to close within 45 days, with audit underway. Halo Privacy contributes ~$7M revenue and $5.5M ARR (~80% of revenue) and ~55% gross margin. Cycurion aims to build an AI-first security platform targeting government, corporate, and retail markets. Watch for closing conditions and integration risk; no break fee mentioned.
